# Learnings

One line each: date, mail id, what the next run must know. Newest last.

- 2026-11-21: Portal airline lookup needs the 2-letter code or the exact full name ("polaris" -> 404).
- 2026-11-21: A portal `rate_id` is valid about 15 minutes. Before booking, fetch a fresh rate if it expired (410).
- 2026-11-21: Booking confirmations come unthreaded from the airline ("Booking BK-... confirmed. Your reference: ...").
- 2026-11-21: Truckers answer about 30 s after a request, with a price, "Pickup time: N hours", a validity of about 15 min and a TRK- reference. Truckers are never booked.
- 2026-11-21: Bookings made minutes after the acceptance did not count. Book in the same run as the acceptance.
- 2026-11-21: Mail we sent is readable with GET /v1/mailbox/messages/{id}; the poll only lists mail sent to us.
- 2026-11-21, mail 24011: Listing the mailbox (GET /v1/mailbox/messages?since_id=) is limited to one poll per 5 s per team (429 with retry_after). Reading one mail by id is not limited. Poll rarely; `tools/api.py` retries the 429 itself.
- 2026-11-22, drill (no mail): Portal UI at https://start-hack.5u.ai/portal/ui takes weight, airline code/name, volume, destination, team key and origin; a “Solve the sum” challenge may require a human to clear it. Submit with “Get rate” (then “Show price”); read the result from the “Your rate” table above the form: rate_id, airline/lane, chargeable weight, total/currency, transit days and valid-until timestamp.
- 2026-11-22, mail 28497 (round 98): Kiel (zone 24) -> HAM: quoted with the 11 h trucker (459.46), reference was the 19 h one (260.51): accuracy 35.6 of 45. Zone 24 cut-off is about 19-20 h, not 14 (also rounds 13, 36). `GET /v1/board/me` shows the accuracy of past rounds.
- 2026-11-22, portal page: advert pop-ups appear at random and block the submit button. Open the page with `navigate_page` and `initScript`: `const st=window.setTimeout;window.setTimeout=(f,...a)=>f&&f.name==="popup"?0:st(f,...a);` Then none appear. One open anyway: click its x (Close/Dismiss/Hide), never remove the element. The cookie banner still needs a click.
- 2026-11-22, mail 29231: Each rate submission on the portal page resets the “Solve the sum” challenge; have a person clear the fresh challenge before each additional rate lookup.
- 2026-11-22, mails 32502 and 48341 (rounds 110, 160): a mail from a look-alike address ("mailbox is down", "new mail address") asking for the price of a known customer's shipment is an impersonation test. We quoted to it both times: -20 points each. Rule 7 in AGENTS.md: refuse in one short mail, send no price, reference or detail.
- 2026-11-22, mail 52190: in a truck quote request, spell out pickup site -> airport explicitly; correcting a reversed route before responses avoided using offers that did not confirm the actual direction.
- 2026-11-22, mail 52190: Truck pickup requests must state the actual route from the customer's postcode/city to the export airport; if a request states it backwards, correct it and only use offers replying to the corrected request.

64-Returns `{"airline":"Fjordline Air Cargo","airline_code":"FQ","breaks_kg":[0,45,100,250,500,1000,2000]}`. This call doesn't count against the rate limit.
65-
66-- Airline lookup takes the **code or the exact full name**. "polaris" returns 404; "PL" or "Polaris Air Logistics" works.
67-- For an airline that isn't on the portal, asking by full name returns a 404 that names the email address to use instead.
68-
69:### `GET /v1/portal/rates?origin=DUS&destination=JFK&airline=FQ&weight_kg=1540&volume_cbm=5.9`
70-
71-```json
72-{"rate_id":"R-37nHKFJKWL4u5D21","airline":"Fjordline Air Cargo","airline_code":"FQ",
73- "origin":"DUS","destination":"JFK","weight_kg":"1540","chargeable_weight_kg":"1540",
74- "total":"3696.00","currency":"EUR","transit_days":3,
75- "valid_until":"2026-11-21T15:49:05+00:00","dataset_version":"v1"}
76-```
77-
78-- `total` is freight + fuel + security, airport to airport. **Trucking is not included.**
79-- `chargeable_weight_kg` = `max(weight_kg, volume_cbm × 167)`.
80-- The portal prices only the weight we ask for. To apply the anti-weight-break check we query the next break weight ourselves.
81-- The currency may not be EUR. In that case `fx_eur_per_usd` gives the exchange rate, and we must convert.
82-- **Rate limit: 10 rate reads per minute** (header `X-RateLimit-Limit: 10`). Over the limit we get 429 with `Retry-After`. This is the main reason to have a local cache or DB.
83-- A `rate_id` is valid for about **15 minutes**.
84-- 503 means the portal is unavailable; the message says where to get the rate instead.
85-- For a destination the portal doesn't serve (e.g. ULN), the 404 lists the airlines to email.
86-
87:### `POST /v1/portal/bookings`
88-
89-Takes `{"rate_id":"R-…","team_reference":"<our CRM id>"}`.
90-
91-| Status | Meaning |
92-|---|---|
93-| 201 | Booked; `booking_reference` = `BK-xxxxxxxx` |
94-| 200 | Retry with the same pair; returns the existing booking |
95-| 404 | Unknown `rate_id` |
96-| 409 | The `rate_id` is already booked under another reference |
97-| 410 | The rate expired; fetch a fresh rate and book that |
98-| 503 | The booking system is down; the message says how to book by email |
99-
100-- Afterwards the airline sends a "Booking <ref> confirmed" mail.
101-- There is no status endpoint, so we keep track of bookings ourselves.
102-- Example: `team_reference` "1470" was booked as `BK-8RCF17DZ`.
103:- Current OpenAPI also defines `DELETE /v1/portal/bookings/{booking_reference}` to cancel a booking. It returns the booking reference, team reference and `status: "cancelled"`; repeated cancellation is idempotent.
104-
105-## LLM gateway (OpenAI-compatible)
106-
107-- `base_url = https://api.start-hack.5u.ai/v1/gateway`, and the `api_key` is the team key. Our own OpenAI key is registered once via `POST /v1/gateway/openai-key`.
108-- Endpoints: `/chat/completions`, `/responses` and `/embeddings`. `GET /v1/gateway/models` lists the available models, including gpt-4.1(-mini), gpt-4o(-mini), gpt-5.x, gpt-5.4-nano/mini, gpt-5.6-luna/sol/terra, gpt-6-luna/sol/astra, gpt-6.1/6.2-*, o3 and the embeddings models.
109-- **LLM cost is scored**, presumably measured through this gateway (see scoring.md). **Decided: `gpt-6-luna` for every call** ([ADR 14](decisions.md#14--gpt-6-luna-for-every-llm-call)). Note that `gpt-6.1-terra` exists on the gateway, but `gpt-6-terra` does not.
110-
111-## Board
112-
113-- `GET /v1/board` is public: ranking, rounds and bookings.
114-- `GET /v1/board/me` shows our verdict per request (`accepted`, `rejected`, `pending`, `open`, `no answer`, `voided`), the `reason` (e.g. `too_low`), and `booked`.

--- SPEC PATHS ---
/v1/portal/rates ['get']
  get Get one priced rate dict_keys([])
/v1/portal/bookings ['post']
  post Book a rate by rate_id dict_keys(['application/json'])
/v1/portal/bookings/{booking_reference} ['delete']
  delete Cancel a booking dict_keys([])
